steps.title: Open a new ticket
steps.description: Click “New ticket” at the top right of My tickets.

steps.title: Describe the problem
steps.description: Give the ticket a short, clear title.

steps.title: Set the priority
steps.description: Choose Low, Medium or High depending on urgency.

steps.title: Create it
steps.description: Click “Create ticket”. It appears at the top of your list.
